prompt: A mining facility in a giant meteor crater, dressed as a hellish lair.

card.name: Meteor Crater Hellmine
card.interpretation: A huge meteor crater is carved into the land, with the mine in its pit and the lair on its rim. Style is infernal: blackstone, nether brick, lava glow. Purpose is a working mine, so the buildings are about extracting and smelting ore, with overseers and workers.
assumptions: Size M, medium density, with the crater filling most of the 64-block claim.
No tavern or chapel, since a hellish lair does not need them.
Terrain is sculpted because a crater does not occur naturally.

program.notes: Spiked basalt keep on the crater rim, lava-lit windows, looks down over the whole pit.
Winch frame and shaft over the crater floor, ore carts, chains descending into the dark.
Lava channels, blast furnaces, smoking chimneys; processes ore from the shaft.
Heavy stone mills with hoppers and rails feeding the foundry.
Grim bunkhouses cut into the crater wall, soot-black, with iron bars.
Small altar of nether brick and crimson fire to the lair's dark master.
Locked vault for ore and guards' weapons.
